research.notes: Google News redirect URLs (CBM... encoded) returned JS-rendered interstitials of ~98c via curl; fell back to publisher mirrors (ABC News, Las Vegas Sun, Yahoo News Canada, VINnews, Al Jazeera, RTE) via WebFetch and to direct curl on BBC/CBS/CNBC. BIS Annual Economic Report 2026 PDF was extracted with pdftotext. The Hill and Reuters direct URLs blocked by bot-detection (PerimeterX/403).

illustrate.notes: All five gpt-image-2 requests returned http.client.IncompleteRead mid-response on both the first attempt and the 10s-backoff retry; proxy appears to be truncating the ~1.4 MB base64-PNG payload. Set has_illustration: false on all five articles per the graceful-degradation rule. Failure reproduced sequentially, so not a parallelism issue. Worth flagging for the illustrate.py owner: the upstream proxy may need a higher response-body cap, or the script could stream the response and recover from IncompleteRead.
